OnPlay.issue: The shape is right -- generate 1 distinct SKILL from the character pool, make it free this turn, add it to hand, in that order. WRONG RNG STREAM: `CardFactory.GetDistinctForCombat(..., 1, Owner.RunState.Rng.CombatCardGeneration)` (Distraction.cs:25-27) names the CombatCardGeneration stream; the sim calls `random_pool_cards(ctx.combat._rng, 1, _CT.SKILL, distinct=True)` (trash_heap_cards.py:113) on the unseeded shared `random.Random`, even though `ctx.combat.combat_rng.card_gen` maps to `combat_card_generation` (combat_rng.py:20,52), and `rng.sample` (pool.py:158) is a different draw sequence from GetDistinctForCombat's. Same mechanism and same verdict as card/anointed, card/beat_down and card/discovery (rule 3). LIVE -- Distraction is a ported Event Skill from the Trash Heap and the parity stream is wired.

guards.rationale: The sim passes `_CT.SKILL` to `random_pool_cards`, whose default pool is IRONCLAD_POOL (pool.py:141), i.e. the character pool. Same membership; only the stream and the draw algorithm diverge, which the OnPlay entry owns.
